svg.title: Parchi
svg.desc: Case file for Parchi, Google Build with AI 2026, Track 04. A field of 1,000 pins, one per farmer: the 68 an extension worker reaches are blue; everyone else is advised by the dealer, on a chit. Parchi's verdict, do not spray this, cycles through 11 Indian languages. A farmer photographs the dealer's chit; Gemini reads it, a rule engine checks every product against India's pesticide register, and the verdict is read aloud. The model reads and explains. It never decides.
